note: What the creatures do, the routes through this place, and what a Remix may change.

locked: Primary locations: Last village, harbor, failing ward stones, buried watch-temple.
Core problem: Protective wards misfire and corrupted creatures threaten the settlement.
open: The snakes are the easy fight before the temple; the hunters' net on the path (VI-WX-01) can wake them.
The gate arch's road-and-hand carving (VI-WX-03) matches the sealed ward door inside.

original.does: Basks coiled in the warm sand of the sunken court, scales shimmering faintly blue along the spine; strikes with a 10-foot reach at anyone who comes down among the pillars.

difficulty.tuner_recommends: one fewer Giant Venomous Snake (plays as moderate); not applied unless the map says so

rewards: creatures that hide in sand and rubble
terrain.gaps: the collapsed entrance is a 10-ft stair; the forecourt is open between four pillars

may_change: the read-aloud and GM lines about them
must_keep: beasts touched by the failing wards (the blue shimmer)
an easy fight before the temple (plays as low, or the GM's target)

filters.movement: walkers; burrowers or swimmers only in the mix

remix.freshness: a remix for returning players avoids Giant Venomous Snakes

routes.when: The party keeps to the forecourt's rim and the fallen gatehouse instead of crossing the sand.
routes.success: The party reaches the collapsed entrance without waking the snakes; they stay basking.
routes.failure: Sand slides under a boot: the snakes uncoil and the fight starts with the party strung out along the rim.
routes.reveals: On the way the party passes under the gate arch and sees the road ending in an open hand (VI-WX-03).
routes.canon: Nothing is skipped: the arch's carving is on the rim route.

routes.when: Someone has fire and dune grass to burn.
routes.success: Smouldering grass drives the snakes out of the court and into the dunes; they do not come back while the smoke lasts (1 hour).
routes.failure: The smoke drifts the wrong way; the snakes strike at the smoker first.
routes.reveals: Under the sand where they lay, the flagstones are carved with a cracked road: the same as the temple nave's mosaic.
routes.canon: Hunters' knowledge, the village's way of living with the island; the source still waits inside.
